section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: 10 Volume of Accidental Deaths per Lakh of Population in the States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities The volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population in States for 1976 was 18.04 while in 1975 it was 18.64. For the Union Territories, it was 38.39 in 1976 compared with 37.30 in 1975. The all-India Volume of the accidental deaths (i.e. States & Union Territories together) per lakh of population was 18.31 in 1976 compared with 18.89 in 1975. The volume of accidental deaths for Metropolitan Cities taken together was 42.06 per lakh of population in 1976 compared with 40.42 for 1975. It shows that the volume of accidental deaths in the Metropolitan Cities was much higher in 1976 when compared with the volume for the States and the Union Territories.
